imagery: No photographs, icons, or illustrations; only a screen-recording mouse cursor arrow near the 'Opening touched points' bullet
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout (Arial-like). Title 'Pre processing' is bold, roughly 24-28pt, black on pale yellow. Lead word 'Preprocessing' is bold red (~20pt); 'is' is regular black; 'Problem dependent and data dependent' is italic and underlined black. 'It may include:' is bold black (~18pt). Bullets are regular black (~18pt) with small round dot markers, one item per line, left-aligned with consistent indentation. No all-caps, no numbered lists.
animation_state: No mid-build state detected; all 10 bullet lines (including the trailing '.......' ellipsis bullet) are visible simultaneously. A mouse cursor hovers near the 7th bullet, indicating a paused screen recording rather than an animation in progress.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8). 2. Draw a thin dark-red (#8B1A1A) horizontal line across the very top edge of the slide. 3. Create a rectangle at top-left (approx. 11% from left, 11% from top, ~23% wide, ~10% tall) filled pale yellow (#FFFFE1) with a 1.5pt blue (#2222CC) border; type 'Pre processing' inside, bold black sans-serif ~26pt, left-aligned. 4. Create a large rectangle below (approx. 10% from left, 23% from top, ~82% wide, ~72% tall) with white fill and 1.5pt blue (#2222CC) border. 5. Inside it, first paragraph: 'Preprocessing' in bold red (#CC2222) ~20pt, followed by 'is ' in regular black, followed by 'Problem dependent and data dependent' in black italic with underline. 6. Next line: 'It may include:' in bold black ~18pt. 7. Below, create a bulleted list with small round black dot markers, one item per line, regular black ~18pt, in this exact order: 'Gap filling', 'Thinning', 'Contour', 'Binarization', 'Noise Removal', 'Color to Gray', 'Opening touched points', 'Resizing', 'Normalization', '.......'. 8. Do not add images, charts, or slide numbers. 9. Optionally, to match the video-frame look, add a black strip across the bottom edge with a small red (#CC0000) square at the bottom-left corner, though this is a player artifact rather than slide content.
